verdict.rationale: ByteAsk's own docs describe an agent that reads the codebase, edits files, compiles, runs tests and presents a diff for review. `byteask exec` runs a task to completion, which covers the core of implementing or fixing code in a repository. Natural-language feature/bug descriptions and coordinated multi-file changes are implied rather than explicitly documented, and there is no independent corroboration, so coverage is not complete. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of plain-language feature/bug prompts driving implementation, explicit evidence of coordinated multi-file edits, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can describe a feature or bug in plain language and have the agent implement or fix it across multiple files

citations.quote: reads your codebase, edits files, compiles, runs tests, and presents a diff for your review before making permanent changes
It edits your repository from the terminal, then drives the real toolchain
it runs one task to completion and exits.
